title: 統合実装計画の単体パッケージ受入
status: I00-I12 implemented and locally accepted; I13 local release accepted, remote CI and real-use acceptance remain

implementation.numerical: FieldSpecと不変CoefficientLayout。物理前提はdecomposerが所有しoffsetはinnerへ委譲。offset float64保持、forced auto診断削除。独立POD/Gappy/pod_svdのKc blocks/rank0/D=0 baseline。旧CK/旧bundleを維持。
implementation.physical: decomposition/physical.pyがHodge/Helmholtzの数値結果と軽量preflightを所有。学習表現に依存しないfield解析。method/params/単位/geometryと境界意味を出力へ接続。
implementation.objectives: PreparedObjectiveによるgrid/observations/hidden、固定support/point・channel・sample重み、selection/CV/final/paired比較の共通化。secondary未定義とprimary失敗を分離。通常採点は予測一度、CVはsample十分統計だけをpool。
implementation.observation_mask_and_bands: 任意NPY sensor/blocked mask、array_index整列とhiddentruth入力除去。raw変換時の参照付随。既計算sample/channel帯coverageとequal/weighted同時被覆率を公開。帯の対象はgrid固定supportを維持。
implementation.execution: 数値確定と要求出力を分離。保存・mode・描画の失敗で有効な数値結果を破棄しない。成功0件でも原因とschema付き表を保持。HTML無効はpreviewなし、有効時は縮小所有copy。
implementation.inputs: 同run/inputへrawを一度変換。canonical入力はcopyしない。外部prepareは参照集合を持つcanonical_datasetとsplitを渡し、後続はraw再変換なし。形式adapter共通_sourcesとStage wrapper所有を整理。
implementation.output: run/model非依存の共通streaming field writer/reader。既存key/file名を保ち座標/topology/単位/domain/観測/calibration supportを付随。NPZとNPYの可搬性・部分読込・失敗時rollbackを確認。
implementation.persistence: 新schema3、旧1/2は旧規則で検証後に互換layoutを付与。実保存stateからbackend要件を導出。実0.7.1全8bundleと旧0.9.0wheel由来6bundleをmatching環境で受入。
implementation.cleanup: 共通最小rank、Gappy trainer/basis二重保持、未使用dense mass生成、point GP予測の未使用std、同一操作A/Z再変換、post:none fitの全train encode、固定supportの反復solve、量変換二重copy、no-op設定/二重runと不要shimを削除。固定supportはmulti-RHS、変動maskは正しい個別solveを維持。

old_models.status: passed in matching producer Python312 environment
old_models.offset_precision: Old offset transform/inverse uses an original-float32 rounding tolerance (2e-6 absolute in this fixture). Expected values remain the actual old-wheel values. No bit-identity claim for the deliberate precision fix.

findings_during_implementation.issue: Mode curve quietly scored grid under observations objective
findings_during_implementation.resolution: numeric curve moved to evaluation and uses the same PreparedObjective; full-coordinate endpoint checked against primary score.

findings_during_implementation.issue: Raw conversion lost the explicit observation-mask path
findings_during_implementation.resolution: resolve against original root, attach mask to canonical input, align array_index once.

findings_during_implementation.issue: Physical params validated but not passed, and Helmholtz HTML used Hodge edge wording
findings_during_implementation.resolution: pass method/params at each caller; shared preflight and method-specific descriptions.

findings_during_implementation.issue: Unused optional regressor recipe was required by provenance for D=0
findings_during_implementation.resolution: provenance records installed optional versions; actual fit/save/load retains its necessary backend requirements; pipeline/analysis D=0 E2E accepted.

findings_during_implementation.issue: Legacy imputation and explicit hidden namespaces were not separated
findings_during_implementation.resolution: resolve compatibility once; legacy field aliases/curve retained, explicit hidden uses hidden names and rejects explicit field metric conflict.

findings_during_implementation.issue: Windows canonical-snapshot test retained an mmap while deleting source
findings_during_implementation.resolution: release the reader before source removal; verify the relocated self-contained snapshot without forcing source deletion through open mappings.

measurements.workload: 128 samples, 32x32x2 float64, fit96/query32, numerical1thread, independent old/new process; score median of 5 warmed calls
measurements.limits: One generated workload, one process per version. This verifies removed work/state; it is not a general speed or memory-bound guarantee.

cleanup.rationale: Existing files with necessary numerical, public or compatibility roles were retained. Ownership moves removed old bodies/helpers instead of forcing directory deletion. No-op duplicate pipeline and internal-shape tests were removed or replaced with independent scientific/public behavior checks.

remaining.item: 代表的な実観測・将来truth・物理用途の受入
remaining.content: 実規模N/格子・点数/Cで全工程の時間/RSS/一時disk、点coverageと解像度、独立将来truthで帯幅/被覆率、Hodgeの単位/topology/境界要求を照合。合成成功と実データの有効性を区別。

remaining.item: リモートCIと単体配布の外部確認
remaining.content: 既存Linux/Windows CIをremoteで実行し、配布先を決める。現在のローカルwheel受入をremote/publication済みとはしない。

remaining.item: 実測ボトルネックに限定した後続容量対策
remaining.content: dense/global SVD、joint/EM、GP、全件配列返却等は必要な状態を持つ。実規模で支配的なものだけ改良。

remaining.item: 別数学仕様を要する拡張
remaining.content: 任意点較正帯、条件/依存sample向け較正、任意PDE境界、3D/移動geometry、中立長期保存形式は別設計。SDK再統合は単体受入後。
